Sam (FinOps): Follow-up from the billing postmortemwe saw delayed ingest windows that inflated token counts for ~5 customers. Need clear owners + timelines for: (1) prod backfill, (2) invoice adjustments, (3) recurrence detection, (4) customer outreach.
Ana (Eng): Ill take the prod backfill and a quick dedupe guard. Plan: small patch today, staging smoke tonight, backfill tomorrow 04:00 UTC.
Ravi (Metering): Ill own recurrence detection. Proposal: P1 if delta >=9% over 2h -> page; P2 if delta >=4% over 24h -> slack. Add 2-window confirmation and a 3k token minimum to avoid noise.
Ellen (SRE): Ill own the ledger diff + invoice adjustment tooling. Need impacted invoice list from FinOps and approval for pro-rated credits in the playbook.
Sam (FinOps): Uploaded impacted_customers_176543.csv to FIN-524 and queued billing reissue job br-20240812-21.
billing-bot: Reissue job queued br-20240812-21 (FIN-524) status=pending.
Ana (Eng): Quick validation query I ran on staging:
```
SELECT customer_id, date_trunc('hour', ts) as hr, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM token_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY customer_id, hr
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 30;
```
Ana (Eng): Staging smoke passed; root cause appears to be a reprocessed shard window during a retry. Patch landed in canary. Backfill scheduled 04:00 UTC tomorrow.
Ravi (Metering): PR for detection + dashboards: github.com/redwood/meters/pull/499. Ill add example notebooks for borderline cases.
Ellen (SRE): Draft reconcile script at //ops/billing/reconcile_dryrun.sh. Dry-run scheduled Mon 09:30 UTC. Will include pro-rata math and a rollback toggle.
Sam (FinOps): Recap and deadlines: Ana - patch + staging smoke (today), prod backfill (tomorrow 04:00 UTC). Ravi - detection rules + dashboards (Fri AM). Ellen - reconcile script + dry-run (Mon 09:30 UTC) and playbook update (next Tue). Finance will draft customer comms after successful dry-run.
Ana (Eng): Ill also add a late-batch latency histogram to the infra metrics.
Ravi (Metering): Will add Grafana panels and alerting.
Ellen (SRE): If dry-run looks good Ill request a Wed production window and coordinate rollback steps.
Sam (FinOps): Please post short status notes here as milestones complete. Ill move FIN-524 to "postmortem actions" once everything is closed. :thumbsup:
